name: Mateo Hernández
title: Full Stack Developer
headline: React · Node.js · TypeScript · Firebase · Multi-tenant SaaS in production

contact.location: Cali, Colombia (UTC-5) · Open to remote work

profile: Full Stack Developer with 3+ years building business software with JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js. Currently the lead developer of a multi-tenant SaaS for restaurants (point of sale, order management and online menu). I start from the business problem: I learn how the client operates, explain it in writing, mock it up before building, deliver in phases with automated tests and document every decision. Experience in data migration, performance, multi-tenant security and AI-assisted development.

bullets: Lead developer of a multi-tenant SaaS for restaurants (point of sale, order management, online menu, single-product landing pages for ads and admin console) built with React, Node.js/Express and Firebase.

Cut sale checkout time in half (from 1,390 ms to ~700 ms) by loading recipes from Firestore level by level instead of one by one, and verified against the order history that inventory is deducted the same way.

Took the point-of-sale REST API from zero to more than 1,700 automated tests while extending it: cash register and reconciliation, purchases with taxes, inventory by location, production and 30 reports.

Turned the menu, the product landing pages and order management into a single codebase for every company, integrated with the point of sale through a versioned order contract with transactions and idempotent IDs that prevent double charges, plus customer notifications via WhatsApp.
Designed a reusable data importer (per-source adapter, preview and rollback) and migrated a restaurant from its previous system: 1,703 customer, supplier and recipe records in about 21 minutes.

Built the internal console that creates companies and turns on their apps (four phases in two days, one approved mockup per phase) and, in three days, a sales demo running the four apps on fictional data. Multi-tenant authentication with Firebase custom tokens, scrypt password hashing and login rate limiting.
Analyze and document each module before changing it (business rules, architecture decision records and phased roadmaps). Work with AI (Claude Code) from specs and acceptance criteria.
Designed and built VetPOS, a point of sale and veterinary management platform ready for multiple clinics, with NestJS, TypeORM, MySQL, React, TypeScript and Docker Compose.
Built 12 backend modules: sales, inventory with stock movements, customers, pets, appointments, services, expenses and Excel reports.
Implemented JWT authentication with three roles (super admin, admin and employee), security headers and request rate limiting.

Built Mini Programs (AXML, ACSS and JavaScript) for Claro's super app: Cinemark Preferencial (second-largest contributor to the repository) and the Templo de la Moda checkout flow (cart, payment summary and shipping details).
Built the plan and service sales flow of Claro's Sales App in Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind CSS: catalog, plan review and admin views.
Acted as the link between clients and the technical team: turned business needs into requirements and supported functional testing through QA.
Technical lead of the Relatoría project for Colombia's Office of the Inspector General (Procuraduría General de la Nación), coordinating team activities and deliverable quality.
Built business solutions with JavaScript, React, Next.js and SQL Server on the Lappiz platform to automate business processes.
Gathered requirements with government agencies and corporate clients, and designed databases for critical processes.
Built Power BI dashboards and automated document generation with jsPDF, working with Scrum, Azure DevOps and Git.
Built proofs of concept for clients across industries with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap and Kendo UI, backed by SQL Server databases and Power BI reports.
